title: Forecast import automation

card.headline: A controlled forecast-import workflow
card.description: I developed an Excel/VBA workflow for transforming source data into a structured import format, with validation, exception review and audit logging.
card.scope_note: Controlled UAT. The 17-field count describes the output schema; business time savings have not yet been measured.

verified_figures.method: Read-only count of populated headers in the saved candidate
verified_figures.scope: Schema size, not a productivity or accuracy measure

business_results.measurement_status: Comparable accepted manual and automated run durations are not yet recorded.

case_outline.label: Problem
case_outline.text: Prepare consistent import data while making mapping and review decisions traceable.

case_outline.label: What I built
case_outline.text: An Excel/VBA transformation workflow with a 17-field output schema, validation and review controls.

case_outline.label: Evidence
case_outline.text: The saved candidate contains 17 populated output headers and dedicated activity, export and review logs.

case_outline.label: Current stage
case_outline.text: Controlled UAT. Production acceptance is a separate approval step.

case_outline.label: Next measurement
case_outline.text: Compare recorded manual and automated completion times for matching test batches, including review and corrections.
